Localisation des stations de relèvement et refoulement des eaux usées Relais renvoyant les eaux usées vers un autre bassin versant. Coverage: Angers Loire Métropole. The portal files it under Réseaux, Energies. Its keywords are assainissement, eaux-usees. The portal shows 244 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-angers-fr-portal.
